description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, targeting Warden of the Eye
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Warden of the Eye
When Warden of the Eye enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cloudshift to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.
